commitments.text:
1. The District must cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance 
with the documents listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.

3. The District must fulfil all commitments and proposed mitigation measures as documented in the 
Application, including commitments and measures contained in supplementary documents and 
correspondence listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.
4.(a) The District must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started and constructed the Project within five years of the issue date of this Certificate.

4.(b) The District must return all disturbed surface lands to their original condition, or as agreed upon with authorities having jurisdiction or ownership, if the District begins construction but does not complete the Project.
4.(c) The District must notify the Executive Director of any plans to abandon the Project prior to operation.

5. The District must, within two months of connecting the Project to the District’s water distribution 
system, report to the reasonable satisfaction of the Executive Director on compliance with the Conditions 
of this Certificate.
